###############################################################
# 1. Introduction
###############################################################

The purpose of this document is to build the reference spectral library of the
HUMAN Metabolomics Ring Trial using exclusively the Bioconductor
RforMassSpectrometry ecosystem.

The final library will be stored as a `CompDb` SQLite database containing

- compound annotations,
- MS/MS spectra,
- acquisition metadata,
- laboratory-specific metadata.

The resulting database constitutes the master representation of the Ring Trial
spectral library and can later be exported to external formats such as MSP or
MassBank.

The workflow implemented in this document follows the strategy proposed in the
official `CompoundDb` vignette while adapting it to the specific needs of the
Ring Trial.

# 4. Read provenance table
###############################################################

```{r}

provenance <-
    read_excel(provenance_file)

provenance
glimpse(provenance)

```

```{r}

# Clean redundant provenance entries

csi_check <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::group_by(
        compound,
        adduct,
        method,
        pass,
        file,
        feature_id
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        n_csi_values = dplyr::n_distinct(csi_score),
        csi_min = min(csi_score, na.rm = TRUE),
        csi_max = max(csi_score, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(n_csi_values > 1)

csi_check

provenance_clean <-
    provenance |>
    # Define each feature within its experimental context
    dplyr::group_by(
        compound,
        adduct,
        method,
        pass,
        file,
        feature_id
    ) |>
    # Check that each feature has a single CSI score
    dplyr::mutate(
        .feature_csi_score = max(csi_score, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    # Compare different feature_ids within the same compound + adduct + method + pass + file group    
    dplyr::group_by(
        compound,
        adduct,
        method,
        pass,
        file
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        .best_csi_score = max(.feature_csi_score, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    # Keep all rows belonging to the feature_id with the highest CSI score    
    dplyr::filter(
        .feature_csi_score == .best_csi_score
    ) |>
    # Remove temporary columns
    dplyr::select(
        -.feature_csi_score,
        -.best_csi_score
    )

cat("Original rows:", nrow(provenance), "\n")
cat("Cleaned rows :", nrow(provenance_clean), "\n")
cat("Rows removed :", nrow(provenance) - nrow(provenance_clean), "\n")

redundant_features <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::group_by(
        compound,
        adduct,
        method,
        pass,
        file,
        feature_id
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
        csi_score = max(csi_score, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_rows = dplyr::n(),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(
        compound,
        adduct,
        method,
        pass,
        file
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        best_csi_score = max(csi_score, na.rm = TRUE),
        redundant = csi_score < best_csi_score
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::filter(redundant)

redundant_features

n_redundant_features <-
    nrow(redundant_features)

n_rows_removed <-
    sum(redundant_features$n_rows)

cat(
    "Redundant features:", n_redundant_features, "\n",
    "Rows removed:", n_rows_removed, "\n"
)

redundant_features |>
    dplyr::select(
        compound,
        adduct,
        method,
        pass,
        file,
        feature_id,
        csi_score,
        best_csi_score,
        n_rows
    )

provenance |>
    dplyr::filter(
        lab == "icl",
        compound == "glutathione",
        file == "C_1_neg_007_Human Endosome_1.1_MS2.mzML"
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
        compound,
        adduct,
        method,
        pass,
        feature_id,
        scan_index,
        acquisition_num,
        rt_sec,
        csi_score
    )

provenance_clean |>
    dplyr::filter(
        lab == "icl",
        compound == "glutathione",
        file == "C_1_neg_007_Human Endosome_1.1_MS2.mzML"
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
        compound,
        adduct,
        method,
        pass,
        feature_id,
        scan_index,
        acquisition_num,
        rt_sec,
        csi_score
    )

# rm(csi_check, provenance_clean, redundant_features, n_redundant_features, n_rows_removed, provenance_clean_file)
```

# 6. Enrich provenance table with information from the standards table and the Ring_trial_setups_summary table
###############################################################

```{r}

###############################################################
# Enrich provenance table with information from the standards table
###############################################################

standards_file <-
    "C:/Users/amart/Desktop/HUMAN Ring Trial/HUMAN_Ring_Trial-main (copia para GitHub)/HUMAN_Ring_Trial/1_preprocessing/standards_extended_with_classes.xlsx"

# Read standards table
# Column names are located in the second row of the Excel file

standards <-
    read_excel(
        standards_file,
        skip = 1
    )

# Columns to import from standards

standards_annotation_columns <- c(
    "InChIKey",
    "ChEBI",
    "KEGG",
    "HMDB",
    "LipidMaps",
    "SMILES",
    "InChI",
    "M",
    "classes"
)

# Check that all required columns are present

missing_standards_columns <-
    setdiff(
        standards_annotation_columns,
        colnames(standards)
    )

if (length(missing_standards_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
        paste(
            "The following columns are missing from standards.xlsx:",
            paste(
                missing_standards_columns,
                collapse = ", "
            )
        )
    )
}

# Check uniqueness of InChIKey in standards (if several standard records share the same InChIKey, prefer the record containing an HMDB identifier)

duplicate_standards_inchikey <-
    standards |>
    dplyr::group_by(InChIKey) |>
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() > 1) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

duplicate_standards_inchikey

# Keep only the required annotation columns, removing duplicated InChIKey

standards_annotations <-
    standards |>
    dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(
            standards_annotation_columns
        )
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
        !HMDB %in% c(
            "HMDB0060079",
            "HMDB0000805",
            "HMDB0029881"
        )
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(InChIKey) |>
    dplyr::filter(
        if (any(!is.na(HMDB))) {
            !is.na(HMDB)
        } else {
            TRUE
        }
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# Re-check uniqueness of InChIKey in standards after cleaning

duplicate_standards_inchikey <-
    standards_annotations |>
    dplyr::group_by(InChIKey) |>
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() > 1) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

duplicate_standards_inchikey

if (nrow(duplicate_standards_inchikey) > 0) {
    stop(
        paste(
            "The standards table contains duplicated InChIKeys with different annotations.",
            "The join may generate multiple rows per provenance entry.",
            "Resolve these duplicates before joining with provenance.",
            paste(
                duplicate_standards_inchikey$InChIKey,
                collapse = ", "
            )
        )
    )
}

# Add standards annotations to provenance

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::left_join(
        standards_annotations,
        by = c(
            "target_InChIKey" = "InChIKey"
        )
    )

# Check the enrichment

provenance |>
    dplyr::select(
        target_InChIKey,
        ChEBI,
        KEGG,
        HMDB,
        LipidMaps,
        SMILES,
        InChI,
        M,
        classes
    ) |>
    head()

n_total <-
    sum(
        !is.na(provenance$target_InChIKey)
    )

n_total

n_matched <-
    sum(
        provenance$target_InChIKey %in%
        standards$InChIKey
    )

n_matched

unmatched_inchikeys <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(target_InChIKey),
        !target_InChIKey %in% standards$InChIKey
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(
        target_InChIKey
    )

unmatched_inchikeys

```

###############################################################
# 7. Adapt provenance table column names/content/format to CompoundDb and MsBackendCompDb conventions
###############################################################

```{r}

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        predicted = FALSE
    )

# Add instrument type

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        instrument_type = "LC-ESI-QTOF"
    )

# Add synonyms

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        synonyms = sirius_structure
    )

# Rename columns to Spectra conventions

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::rename(
        rtime = rt_sec,
        acquisitionNum = acquisition_num,
        scanIndex = scan_index,
        inchi = InChI,
        instrument = LC_instrument,
        name = compound, # ChEBI names 
        formula = molecular_formula,
        inchikey = target_InChIKey,
        exactmass = M,
        compound_class = classes
    )

# Convert exact mass to CompDb-compatible numeric values

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        exactmass = as.numeric(exactmass)
    )

```

###############################################################
# 8. Locate mzML files
###############################################################

```{r}

find_mzml_file <-
function(lab,
         mzml_name,
         polarity,
         mzml_dirs){
    if(lab == "afekta"){
        directory <- mzml_dirs$AFEKTA
    }
    else if(lab == "hmgu"){
        directory <- mzml_dirs$HMGU
    }
    else if(lab == "cembio"){
        if(polarity == "pos"){
            directory <- mzml_dirs$CEMBIO_POS
        } else if(polarity == "neg"){
            directory <- mzml_dirs$CEMBIO_NEG
        } else {
            stop(
                paste(
                    "Invalid polarity for CEMBIO:",
                    polarity
                )
            )
        }
    }
    else{
        stop(
            paste(
                "Unknown laboratory:",
                lab
            )
        )
    }
    candidate <-
        file.path(
            directory,
            mzml_name
        )
    if(!file.exists(candidate)){
        stop(
            paste(
                "File not found:",
                candidate
            )
        )
    }
    candidate
}

```

# 9. Split provenance table by mzML file

```{r}

provenance_split <-
    split(
        provenance,
        provenance$mzml_path
    )

length(provenance_split)

```

###############################################################
# 10. Read mzML
###############################################################

```{r}

read_mzml <- function(file){
    Spectra(
        file,
        backend = MsBackendMzR()
    )
}

```

###############################################################
# 11. Extract required scans
###############################################################

```{r}

extract_required_spectra <-
function(sp, provenance_subset) {
    scan_numbers <- provenance_subset$acquisitionNum
    idx <- match(
        scan_numbers,
        acquisitionNum(sp)
    )
    if (anyNA(idx)) {
        missing_scans <- scan_numbers[is.na(idx)]
        mzml_file <- unique(provenance_subset$file)
        stop(
            "In file ", mzml_file,
            " the following acquisition numbers were not found: ",
            paste(missing_scans, collapse = ", ")
        )
    }
    sp <- sp[idx]
    sp
}

```

###############################################################
# 12. Read all mzML files
###############################################################

```{r}

spectra_list <- vector(
    "list",
    length(provenance_split)
)

names(spectra_list) <-
    names(provenance_split)

# Read spectra

for(i in seq_along(provenance_split)){
    message(
        "Reading ",
        basename(
            names(provenance_split)[i]
        )
    )
    prov <-
        provenance_split[[i]]
    sp <-
        read_mzml(
            unique(
                prov$mzml_path
            )
        )
    sp <-
        extract_required_spectra(
            sp,
            prov
        )
    spectra_list[[i]] <- sp
}

```

```{r}

# Check that all mzML files have been read

length(spectra_list)
sapply(
    spectra_list,
    length
)

```

```{r}

# Remove unnecessary values/objects previously created

rm(i, prov, sp)

```

###############################################################
# 13. Combine all spectra
###############################################################

```{r}

# As detailed in the documentation of the Spectra class, a Spectra object is a container for mass spectrometry (MS) data that includes both the mass peaks data (or peaks data, generally m/z and intensity values) as well as spectra metadata (so called spectra variables). Spectra variables generally define one value per spectrum, while for peaks variables one value per mass peak is defined and hence multiple values per spectrum (depending on the number of mass peaks of a spectrum).
# Data can be extracted from a Spectra object using dedicated accessor functions or also using the $ operator. Depending on the backend class used by the Spectra to represent the data, data can also be added or replaced (again, using dedicated functions or using ⁠$<-⁠).

ring_trial_spectra <- concatenateSpectra(spectra_list)

```

```{r}

# Checking

ring_trial_spectra

spectraVariables(ring_trial_spectra)
length(ring_trial_spectra)
peaksData(ring_trial_spectra)
mz(ring_trial_spectra)
intensity(ring_trial_spectra)

example <- ring_trial_spectra[1]
mz(example)[[1]]
intensity(example)[[1]]

methods("peaksData")
showMethods("peaksData")

```

```{r}
rm(example)
```

###############################################################
# 14. Rebuild the provenance table in the correct order and with identifiers
###############################################################

```{r}

# Rebuild the provenance table in the correct order (provenance_split), with the corresponding compound_id and spectrum_id (internal identifiers for CompDb)

provenance <-
    dplyr::bind_rows(provenance_split) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        compound_id =
            match(
                inchikey,
                unique(inchikey)
            ),
        compound_id =
            as.character(compound_id),
        spectrum_id =
            seq_len(n())
    )

# Check whether ‘provenance’ is correctly aligned with ‘ring_trial_spectra’

all(
    provenance$acquisitionNum ==
        acquisitionNum(ring_trial_spectra)
)

# Check that there are no ‘NA’ values in ‘compound_id’

stopifnot(
    !anyNA(provenance$compound_id)
)

# Check that there are no ‘NA’ values in ‘spectrum_id’

stopifnot(
    !anyNA(provenance$spectrum_id)
)

# Check that there are no duplicated values in ‘spectrum_id’

stopifnot(
    !anyDuplicated(provenance$spectrum_id)
)

# Check that there are no InChIKey ‘NA’ values (in ‘inchikey’)

stopifnot(
    !anyNA(provenance$inchikey)
)

# Check that all spectra with exactly the same InChIKey are assigned the same compound_id

compound_id_check <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::distinct(
        inchikey,
        compound_id
    )

compound_id_check

compound_id_check <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::distinct(
        compound_id,
        inchikey
    ) |>
    dplyr::count(compound_id) |>
    dplyr::filter(n > 1)

stopifnot(nrow(compound_id_check) == 0)

```

```{r}

# Remove unnecessary values/objects previously created

rm(compound_id_check)

```

###############################################################
# 15. Build the compound annotation table (one of the tables that `createCompDb()` expects)
###############################################################

```{r}

# Create the compound annotations table (Compound-level) in the correct order (provenance_split) and with the corresponding compound_id (internal identifier for CompDb), containing a single row per compound

compound_annotations <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::select(
        compound_id,
        name,
        inchikey,
        inchikey_2d,
        formula,
        ChEBI,
        KEGG,
        HMDB,
        LipidMaps,
        SMILES,
        inchi,
        exactmass,
        compound_class,
        synonyms
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(compound_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

head(compound_annotations)

```

###############################################################

###############################################################

```{r}

    data.frame(

            provenance$file,
        precursor_mz_raw =
            provenance$precursor_mz_raw,
        precursor_mz_med =
            provenance$precursor_mz_med,
        n_peaks =
            provenance$n_peaks,
        csi_score =
            provenance$csi_score,
        details =
            provenance$details,
        instrument_type =
            provenance$instrument_type,
        instrument =
            provenance$instrument,
        column =
            provenance$column,
        mobile_phase_A =
            provenance$mobile_phase_A,
        mobile_phase_B =
            provenance$mobile_phase_B,        
        H2O =
            provenance$H2O,
        ACN =
            provenance$ACN,
        formic_acid =
            provenance$formic_acid,    
        duration_min =
            provenance$duration_min,
        inj_vol_uL_pos =
            provenance$inj_vol_uL_pos,
        inj_vol_uL_neg =
            provenance$inj_vol_uL_neg,        
        MS_instrument =
            provenance$MS_instrument,
        source =
            provenance$source,
        mass_range =
            provenance$mass_range,        
        DDA_DIA =
            provenance$DDA_DIA,
        fragmentation =
            provenance$fragmentation,
        number_of_injections =
            provenance$number_of_injections,        
        total_scan_rate_MS1_MS2 =
            provenance$total_scan_rate_MS1_MS2,

            provenance$total_scan_rate_MS1_seg_pos,
        total_scan_rate_MS1_seg_neg =

        total_scan_rate_MS2_seg =

        inclusion_list =
            provenance$inclusion_list,

        MTBLS_public_status =
            provenance$MTBLS_public_status,
        MTBLS_access_link =
            provenance$MTBLS_access_link,
        ms_level =
            msLevel(ring_trial_spectra),
        scanIndex =
            scanIndex(ring_trial_spectra),
        acquisitionNum =
            acquisitionNum(ring_trial_spectra),
        precScanNum =
            precScanNum(ring_trial_spectra),
        dataStorage =
            dataStorage(ring_trial_spectra),
        dataOrigin =
            dataOrigin(ring_trial_spectra),
        smoothed =
            smoothed(ring_trial_spectra),
        centroided =

# Adding mz

msms_spectra$mz <-
```

###############################################################
# 23. Validate spectral integrity
###############################################################

```{r}

###############################################################
# 23.1. Basic checks
###############################################################

# Obtain compound_id identifiers from original data and retrieved data

original_compounds_ids <-
    unique(
        as.character(
            msms_spectra$compound_id
        )
    )

retrieved_compounds_ids <-
    unique(
        as.character(
            spectraData(
                ring_trial_library,
                columns = "compound_id"
            )$compound_id
        )
    )

# Validate compound_id identifiers

stopifnot(
    length(original_compounds_ids) == length(retrieved_compounds_ids)
)

cat(
    "Number of original compounds:",
    length(original_compounds_ids),
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Number of retrieved compounds:",
    length(retrieved_compounds_ids),
    "\n"
)

# Check that the same compound_id identifiers are present

stopifnot(
    setequal(
        original_compounds_ids,
        retrieved_compounds_ids
    )
)

cat(
    "The same compound_id identifiers are present in both objects.\n"
)

missing_compounds_ids <-
    setdiff(
        original_compounds_ids,
        retrieved_compounds_ids
    )

missing_compounds_ids

# Obtain spectrum_id identifiers from original data and retrieved data

original_spectra_ids <-
    as.character(
        msms_spectra$spectrum_id
    )

retrieved_spectra_ids <-
    as.character(
        spectraData(
            ring_trial_library,
            columns = "spectrum_id"
        )$spectrum_id
    )

# Validate spectrum_id identifiers

stopifnot(
    length(original_spectra_ids) == length(retrieved_spectra_ids)
)

cat(
    "Number of original spectra:",
    length(original_spectra_ids),
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Number of retrieved spectra:",
    length(retrieved_spectra_ids),
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Number of unique original spectrum_id identifiers:",
    length(unique(original_spectra_ids)),
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Number of unique retrieved spectrum_id identifiers:",
    length(unique(retrieved_spectra_ids)),
    "\n"
)

# Check that spectrum_id identifiers are unique in both objects

stopifnot(
    !anyDuplicated(original_spectra_ids)
)

stopifnot(
    !anyDuplicated(retrieved_spectra_ids)
)

# Check that the same spectrum_id identifiers are present

stopifnot(
    setequal(
        original_spectra_ids,
        retrieved_spectra_ids
    )
)

cat(
    "The same spectrum_id identifiers are present in both objects.\n"
)

missing_spectra_ids <-
    setdiff(
        original_spectra_ids,
        retrieved_spectra_ids
    )

missing_spectra_ids

```

```{r}

###############################################################
# 23.2. Validate one specific spectrum
###############################################################

# Build spectrum_id tables

original_index <-
    setNames(
        seq_along(original_spectra_ids),
        original_spectra_ids
    )

retrieved_index <-
    setNames(
        seq_along(retrieved_spectra_ids),
        retrieved_spectra_ids
    )

# Test specific spectrum_id

sid <- "100"

original_idx <-
    original_index[[sid]]

retrieved_idx <-
    retrieved_index[[sid]]

cat(
    "Testing spectrum_id:",
    sid,
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Original position:",
    original_idx,
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Retrieved position:",
    retrieved_idx,
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Original acquisitionNum:",
    acquisitionNum(ring_trial_spectra)[original_idx],
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Retrieved acquisitionNum:",
    acquisitionNum(ring_trial_library)[retrieved_idx],
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Original compound_id:",
    msms_spectra$compound_id[original_idx],
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Retrieved compound_id:",
    spectraData(
        ring_trial_library,
        columns = "compound_id"
    )$compound_id[retrieved_idx],
    "\n"
)

# Extract the same spectrum from both objects

original <-
    ring_trial_spectra[original_idx]

retrieved <-
    ring_trial_library[retrieved_idx]

# Compare m/z

mz_identical <-
    isTRUE(
        all.equal(
            mz(original)[[1]],
            mz(retrieved)[[1]]
        )
    )

cat(
    "m/z identical:",
    mz_identical,
    "\n"
)

# Compare intensities

intensity_identical <-
    isTRUE(
        all.equal(
            intensity(original)[[1]],
            intensity(retrieved)[[1]]
        )
    )

cat(
    "Intensity identical:",
    intensity_identical,
    "\n"
)

# Compare precursor m/z

precursor_identical <-
    isTRUE(
        all.equal(
            precursorMz(original),
            precursorMz(retrieved)
        )
    )

cat(
    "Precursor m/z identical:",
    precursor_identical,
    "\n"
)

# Compare collision energy

collision_energy_identical <-
    isTRUE(
        all.equal(
            collisionEnergy(original),
            collisionEnergy(retrieved)
        )
    )

cat(
    "Collision energy identical:",
    collision_energy_identical,
    "\n"
)

# Compare number of peaks

number_peaks_identical <-
    isTRUE(
        all.equal(
            length(mz(original)[[1]]),
            length(mz(retrieved)[[1]])
        )
    )

cat(
    "Number of peaks identical:",
    number_peaks_identical,
    "\n"
)

```

```{r}

###############################################################
# 23.3. Validate a random set of 20 spectra
###############################################################

# Random test of 20 spectra

set.seed(123)

test_ids <-
    sample(
        original_spectra_ids,
        20
    )

for (sid in test_ids) {

    original_idx <-
        original_index[[sid]]

    retrieved_idx <-
        retrieved_index[[sid]]
    
    original <- ring_trial_spectra[original_idx]

    retrieved <- ring_trial_library[retrieved_idx]
    
    stopifnot(
        isTRUE(
            all.equal(
                mz(original)[[1]],
                mz(retrieved)[[1]]
            )
        )
    )

    stopifnot(
        isTRUE(
            all.equal(
                intensity(original)[[1]],
                intensity(retrieved)[[1]]
            )
        )
    )

    stopifnot(
        isTRUE(
            all.equal(
                precursorMz(original),
                precursorMz(retrieved)
            )
        )
    )

    stopifnot(
        isTRUE(
            all.equal(
                collisionEnergy(original),
                collisionEnergy(retrieved)
            )
        )
    )
}

cat(
    "Random spectral integrity test passed for 20 spectra.\n"
)
```

```{r}
src
```

```{r}
# 27.4 Record title

massbank_library$title <- paste(
    massbank_library$name,
    "LC-ESI-QTOF",
    "MS2",
    paste0("CE ", massbank_library$collisionEnergy, " eV"),
    massbank_library$adduct,
    sep = "; "
)

# Replace missing values in "title" components rather than writing "NA" into the record title

massbank_title_components <- list(
    massbank_library$name,
    rep("LC-ESI-QTOF", length(massbank_library)),
    rep("MS2", length(massbank_library)),
    ifelse(
        is.na(massbank_library$collisionEnergy),
        NA_character_,
        paste0(
            "CE ",
            massbank_library$collisionEnergy,
            " eV"
        )
    ),
    massbank_library$adduct
)

massbank_library$title <- vapply(
    seq_along(massbank_library),
    function(i) {
        parts <- vapply(
            massbank_title_components,
            function(x) as.character(x[i]),
            character(1)
        )

        paste(
            parts[!is.na(parts) & nzchar(parts)],
            collapse = "; "
        )
    },
    character(1)
)

stopifnot(
    all(
        !is.na(massbank_library$title),
        massbank_library$title != ""
    )
```

```{r}

# 27.15 Compound class

# Normalize the hierarchy of chemical classes

normalize_compound_class <- function(x) {
    vapply(x, function(class_string) {

        if (is.na(class_string) || !nzchar(trimws(class_string))) {
            return(NA_character_)
        }

        # Separate by tabs
      
        classes <- strsplit(
            class_string,
            split = "\t",
            fixed = TRUE
        )[[1]]

        # Remove spaces and empty elements
        
        classes <- trimws(classes)
        classes <- classes[nzchar(classes)]

        # Remove duplicates whilst preserving the order
        
        classes <- classes[!duplicated(classes)]

        # Semicolon-separated list format
        
        paste(classes, collapse = "; ")
    }, character(1))
}

massbank_library$massbank_compound_class <-
    normalize_compound_class(massbank_library$compound_class)

# Check the results

head(massbank_library$massbank_compound_class, 5)

    all(
        !is.na(massbank_library$massbank_compound_class),
        massbank_library$massbank_compound_class != ""
    )
)
```

```{r}
# 27.20 Scan settings

scan_setting_vars <- c(
    "total_scan_rate_MS1_MS2",
    "total_scan_rate_MS1_seg_pos",
    "total_scan_rate_MS1_seg_neg",
    "total_scan_rate_MS2_seg"
)

massbank_library$ms_scan_setting <- vapply(
    seq_along(massbank_library),
    function(i) {
        values <- vapply(
            scan_setting_vars,
            function(v) as.character(massbank_library[[v]][i]),
            character(1)
        )

        keep <- !is.na(values) & nzchar(values)

        if (!any(keep)) {
            return(NA_character_)
        }

        paste(
            paste0(scan_setting_vars[keep], ": ", values[keep]),
            collapse = "; "
        )
    },
    character(1)
)
```

###############################################################
# 28. Future developments
###############################################################

The workflow presented here establishes the basic infrastructure for the HUMAN
Ring Trial spectral library.

Future versions of the library may include:

- additional participating laboratories (e.g. ICL);
- all Ring Trial mixtures beyond the Human Endosome subset;
- additional compound annotations (SMILES, PubChem CID, HMDB, ChEBI);
- instrument metadata;
